# GEO + SEO Review

Use this workflow when reviewing or improving this construction/interior-design website for search visibility.

## Goals
- Improve discoverability in AI-powered search assistants and traditional search engines.
- Preserve truthful, useful content and avoid keyword stuffing or fabricated authority signals.
- Prefer concrete site improvements over speculative ranking claims.

## Review areas
1. AI citability: clear service descriptions, project types, service area, process, and contact information.
2. Brand/entity clarity: consistent Zion Calvary Construction and Interior Designing identity, proprietor/business details, official contact channels, and service descriptions.
3. AI crawler access: inspect robots.txt for accidental blocking of legitimate search/AI crawlers.
4. llms.txt: recommend or generate only when useful; keep it factual and aligned with the actual site.
5. Structured data: valid Organization/LocalBusiness/ProfessionalService, Service, WebSite, BreadcrumbList, and FAQ only when matching visible content exists.
6. Technical SEO: title, meta description, canonical, sitemap, robots.txt, HTTPS, mobile usability, performance, internal linking, image alt text.
7. Content quality: real projects, construction/interior expertise, process, trust details, freshness, and clear conversion paths.
8. Local discoverability: consistent business name, service location, contact details, maps/directions if publicly provided.

## Rules
- Never invent projects, testimonials, certifications, awards, registration details, service areas, ratings, or schema properties.
- Do not add FAQ schema unless the matching FAQ content is visibly present.
- Do not create fake city pages or doorway pages.
- Keep human usability, accessibility, and credibility ahead of SEO tricks.
- Explain significant SEO/GEO changes and verify they do not break the site.

## Before delivery
- Check titles/descriptions are unique and relevant.
- Check canonical URLs and sitemap/robots references.
- Validate JSON-LD syntax and factual accuracy.
- Check mobile layout, image optimization, and page speed basics.
- Check internal links, project/gallery pages, service sections, and calls to action.
- Summarize what changed, what was verified, and what requires owner confirmation.

Inspired by the open-source geo-seo-claude workflow from zubair-trabzada/geo-seo-claude.
